texts.li: Someone at dinner came close to a sore subject. {B_nameDef} changed it, smoothly, without looking at {A_nameDef}.
{B_nameDef} sat down beside {A_nameDef} when the questions started, and answered most of them for {A_objective}.
When the talk turned to where everyone came from, {B_nameDef} caught {A_nameDef}'s eye and steered it somewhere else.
{B_nameDef} snapped at {A_nameDef} over nothing, then muttered something about "what I know." {A_nameDef} went pale.
{B_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, under {B_possessive} breath, that keeping {A_possessive} secret was getting heavy, and it sounded more like a warning than a complaint.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} sat by the graves and talked about {FACTION} until the fire went out. They made each other a promise.
{A_nameDef} carved a mark into the wall for every one of {FACTION} that has fallen. {B_nameDef} handed over the knife for the next one.
{B_nameDef} made fun of {A_nameDef}'s habit ({QUIRK}) at supper, and {A_nameDef} didn't laugh.
{B_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef}, loudly, whether {QUIRK} actually works, and got a laugh from the table.
{B_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} about {A_possessive} habit ({QUIRK}), expecting a joke, and got a real story instead. They talked a long time.
{B_nameDef} caught {A_nameDef} at it ({QUIRK}) and, instead of laughing, joined in.
{B_nameDef} has started doing it too ({QUIRK}), just in case {A_nameDef} is right.
{A_nameDef} admitted to {B_nameDef} wanting to {GOAL}, and {B_nameDef} didn't laugh. "Then do it," {B_nameDef} said.
Every evening {B_nameDef} asks {A_nameDef} how the plan to {GOAL} is coming along, and listens to the whole answer.
{B_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} that if anyone here could {GOAL}, it was {A_objective}.
{B_nameDef} found out {A_nameDef} wants to {GOAL}, and laughed in {A_possessive} face.
"You want to {GOAL}?" {B_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef}, loud enough for the whole table to hear, and a few of them laughed.
{B_nameDef} spent a free evening helping {A_nameDef}, who means to {GOAL} one day.
{B_nameDef} gave up a rest day to help {A_nameDef} with the plan to {GOAL}. {A_nameDef} didn't know what to say.
{B_nameDef} spent the afternoon helping {A_nameDef} toward {A_possessive} plan to {GOAL}, and wouldn't take thanks for it.
